creator_request: Montage of our lunch at Don Julio in Buenos Aires. Open on the waiter smiling at the camera and keep his name exchange audible ("What's your name?" "Lucas."). Then the sauce bowls, the big wooden menus, and the cheers under the Don Julio sign; keep that "Cheers!" audible too. End on my friend in the red cap smiling at the camera. Skip the blurry shot of the empty table. Put "chimichurri + salsa criolla" on the sauce bowls. Title: "Lunch at Don Julio :flag-ar:". Suggest an upbeat tango song for it. Make it 15 seconds.
